applied_fixes.source_reading: The coefficient family in the linear-form reduction proof is indexed by n: a_n and a_n^{(i)}.
applied_fixes.before: Gesamtheit der Koeffizienten a_1 ... b_1 a^{(1)} + ... + b_rho a^{(rho)}
